title: NMDC Targets 24 MTPA Pellet Production Capacity as It Plans to Scale Up Iron Ore Output to 100 MT
dek: NMDC is targeting 24 MTPA of pellet capacity as it plans to scale iron ore output to 100 MT, according to Indian Masterminds.
summary: NMDC is targeting 24 MTPA of pellet production capacity as part of plans to raise iron ore output to 100 MT, according to an Indian Masterminds headline. No excerpt was provided, so timelines and investment figures are not available in the material.
keyFacts: Plan to scale iron ore output to 100 MT
whyItMatters: As India's largest iron ore miner, NMDC's expansion plans bear directly on raw material availability for domestic steel capacity growth.
implications: Steelmakers could benefit from greater ore and pellet supply over time, which may influence domestic iron ore pricing.
